Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
feat: Improve face detection accuracy and simplify fight detection

- Enhanced face recognition with better detection parameters
  * Increased confidence threshold: 0.25 → 0.5
  * Larger embedding size: 112x112 → 128x128
  * Stricter matching threshold: 0.48 → 0.55
  * Minimum face size: 16px → 40px
  * Tighter NMS IoU: 0.4 → 0.3

- Improved preprocessing pipeline
  * Added face quality checks (blur detection, minimum resolution)
  * Enhanced CLAHE clip limit: 2.0 → 3.0
  * Added bilateral filter for edge-preserving smoothing
  * Switched to INTER_CUBIC interpolation
  * Added histogram equalization

- Better Haar cascade parameters
  * Scale factor: 1.05 → 1.1
  * Min neighbors: 4 → 6
  * Min size: 30px → 50px
  * Added histogram equalization preprocessing

- Simplified fight detection algorithm
  * Removed complex pose smoothing and buffering
  * Removed occlusion filtering
  * Streamlined to core metrics (body proximity, limb crossings, contacts)
  * Cleaner, more maintainable code

- Added CLAUDE.md documentation for future AI assistants
  * Development commands and setup
  * Architecture overview and processing pipeline
  * Configuration parameters and API routes
  * Code patterns and known issues

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")
